meta.name: knowledge-agent
meta.description: Build and query AI-powered knowledge bases from claude-mem observations. Use when users want to create focused "brains" from their observation history, ask questions about past work patterns, or compile expertise on specific topics.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从对话历史构建可查询的知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望从日常对话中自动提炼知识并随时查询
copy.tagline_en: Build queryable knowledge bases from conversation history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to automatically extract knowledge from daily conversations and query it anytime

howto.what: 装了这个技能后,Claude能根据你的操作历史记录,创建聚焦某个主题的知识库(称为“语料库”)。它会加载这些素材,基于它们回答你的提问,并记住追问的上下文;你也能列出、重建或重新加载已有知识库。
howto.when: 当你想把操作历史整理成专题“大脑”、询问过去的工作模式、或汇总某主题的专业知识时,这个技能就会接管。

say.text: 把我的历史记录里关于钩子机制的资料整理成一个知识库
say.note: 会构建一个“钩子机制”专题语料库

say.text: 基于刚才的知识库,回答钩子生命周期有哪些阶段
say.note: 会从该语料库检索答案并保持追问上下文

say.text: 列出我建过的所有知识库及状态
say.note: 会显示各语料库的统计与加载状态

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude turns your activity history into focused knowledge bases (corpora), loads them into a session, answers questions with follow-up context, and can list, rebuild, or reprime them.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to create a focused 'brain' from observation history, ask about past work patterns, or compile expertise on a topic.

say_en.text: Compile the hook-related material in my history into a knowledge base.
say_en.note: Builds a corpus focused on hooks.

say_en.text: From the knowledge base we just built, what are the hook lifecycle stages?
say_en.note: Answers from the corpus and keeps follow-up context.

say_en.text: List all knowledge bases I've created and their status.
say_en.note: Shows stats and priming status for each corpus.
